definition.simple: The laziness of an object! It wants to keep doing whatever it is currently doing (staying still or moving).
definition.academic: The inherent property of a body to resist any change in its state of rest or of uniform motion in a straight line.

examples: Dust flying off a carpet when beaten with a stick.
Falling backward when a train suddenly starts.

common_misconceptions: Inertia is a force. (Correction: It is a property of mass, not a force.)
ai_context.tutor_hint: Relate it to how hard it is to wake up on a cold morning (laziness/inertia).
